title: Same coarse readout / same core witness / distinct History lineages
interpretation: The unqualified core bundle is not universally lineage-separating. Explicit History is sufficient for this counterexample, but global minimality of the full History trace is not established.
source_basis: RESOLUTION_READOUT::S35 RL8 / RL-T2: formal identities may be observationally conflated by non-injective Resolution maps
IDENTITY_THROUGH_HISTORY::D39 + Formal/02: Identity Witness certifies declared Identity class; History is a separate ordered structure
IDENTITY_THROUGH_HISTORY::Formal/01: History is an ordered composable path and inverse is not assumed
HOLONOMY_CHIRALITY::HC-T8: same endpoint and preserved residue do not force path equivalence
guard: If a concrete Identity Witness implementation already retains a history-separating token, then that implementation may satisfy the criterion without an additional full History trace. The theorem below tests separation, not field names.
